plugins.name: gemini-creative-plugin
plugins.description: MCP-driven image generation toolkit with auto-activating skills for game asset workflows, UI mockup series, character sprites, and prompt engineering. Wraps Google's Gemini 3 image models (Nano Banana 2 default, Nano Banana Pro) behind a sessions-first API designed for LLM agent consumers.
